subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt this gated Claw v1 package family and persistent manifest contract, with the proposed multi-PR merge and deployment sequence?
rationale: Tests can validate implementation details, but they cannot decide whether ClawHub should permanently add this experimental package family, stored schema, public compatibility commitment, and coordinated rollout boundary while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve the staged contract
options.body: Accept the gated Claw v1 direction, then require ordered merges, a clean rebase, and live enabled/disabled lifecycle proof before deployment activation.

options.title: Narrow this slice
options.body: Keep validation and authoring work but remove publication or persistent-storage changes until the RFC and migration contract are settled.

options.title: Pause the Claw stack
options.body: Leave the experimental branches unmerged until maintainers decide that Claw packages belong in ClawHub's near-term product scope.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged contract
recommendation.body: Accept the gated Claw v1 direction, then require ordered merges, a clean rebase, and live enabled/disabled lifecycle proof before deployment activation.
